kpjue01.title: Aries Skips the Scenery
kpjue01.caption:
Date one: amazing. Date two: already planned, during date one.
Jupiter just wants Aries to enjoy the scenic route. Who in your life speedruns every crush?

kpjue02.title: Taurus Takes a New Seat
kpjue02.caption:
Comfort is good. Comfort on repeat can quietly keep love out.
Keep one familiar thing and change one small thing: same café, new seat, a hello. Save this for your next Saturday.

kpjue03.title: Gemini's Six Saturdays
kpjue03.caption:
Six group chats. Six Saturday plans. One Gemini who said yes to all of them.
When the planet of more says it's too much, it's too much. Which plan would you keep?

kpjue04.title: Jupiter Can't Fit Through Cancer's Door
kpjue04.caption:
Saying no to every invite after getting hurt makes sense. It also keeps the good things out.
One text back, one small yes. Home will still be there when you get back.

kpjue05.title: Two Giants, One Spotlight
kpjue05.caption:
Waiting to be asked out with a grand gesture? Jupiter has notes.
The biggest planet says the best move is going first with a kind word. Which Leo in your chat needs this?

kpjue06.title: Virgo's Very Long List
kpjue06.caption:
Ruling someone out over their shoes? That list might be doing too much.
Keep the dealbreakers and let the nitpicks go. Kind, honest and makes you laugh is a great start.

kpjue07.title: Libra Spins Jupiter
kpjue07.caption:
Forty minutes of "I don't mind, you pick" and still no plan.
Jupiter turned himself into a prize wheel to help. Tacos or mini golf, and how long would it take you to choose?

kpjue08.title: Scorpio's Curtain Call
kpjue08.caption:
Third date and they still only know your name? Opening up can feel like too much.
You don't owe anyone everything. Share one true thing, then let them share one back.

kpjue09.title: Sagittarius Packs for Two
kpjue09.caption:
They said "I really like you" and Sagittarius booked a flight within a minute.
Uncle Jupiter has a story about travelling and staying. Wait till you see what's in the suitcase.

kpjue10.title: Capricorn's Fifteen-Minute Date
kpjue10.caption:
A date squeezed between two meetings, with the clock checked six times, isn't really a date.
Block a whole evening and put the phone away. Save this for your busiest week.

kpjue11.title: Aquarius Brings the Weird
kpjue11.caption:
Hiding your weird on a date and talking about the weather instead.
Jupiter has dozens of moons and no two are alike. What's the hobby you'd talk about for an hour?

kpjue12.title: Pisces, Who Looks After You?
kpjue12.caption:
Always the friend on the 2 a.m. call, never the one who calls?
Showing up for people is a gift. So is resting and asking: can I call you tomorrow? Fill your own cup too.
